fresh_population_anchors.note: MODEL CHECK: share of the accepted worlds that still pass every enforced anchor on a fresh device population of the same size

other_worlds_check.note: MODEL PREDICTIONS conditional on the literature anchors; oracle 'best-of-batch' score; not measurements

mask_additions_interior.note: MODEL PREDICTIONS conditional on the literature anchors; additions restricted to the interior box (arm ratio >= 0.6, 4.5 <= w <= 7.5 um, 13 <= L <= 19 um); scored on the unseen test worlds

mask_family_a_rounded.note: MODEL PREDICTIONS; family A recomputed with corner fraction rho (arm tips rounded), family B unchanged
